meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 生成极简提交信息,遵循 Conventional Commits 格式,标题不超过50字符(硬上限72),仅在“为什么”不明显时加入正文。只输出可粘贴的代码块,不执行 git commit、不暂存文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成提交信息(如“write a commit”“commit message”等),或调用 /commit 等命令,或暂存区有更改时自动触发。

say.text: 可以用“write a commit”帮我生成提交信息
say.note: 触发技能输出Conventional Commits格式消息

say.text: 对暂存区的改动执行“generate commit”
say.note: 基于暂存差异生成精简提交信息
直接进入该技能并输出代码块

howto.what_en: Generates ultra-compressed commit messages in Conventional Commits format, subject ≤50 chars (hard cap 72), body only when the 'why' isn't obvious. Outputs a paste-ready code block; never runs git commit, stages files, or amends.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to generate a commit message (e.g., 'write a commit', 'commit message', etc.), invokes /commit or similar, or when files are staged.

say_en.text: Use "write a commit" to generate a commit message
Run "generate commit" on the staged changes
